bias.zh: 转为偏空 · 跌破 100 日均线

read.en: Micron fell 3.6% on Oct 13 to $953.19 and is down 9% in five sessions. It closed below its 100-day average ($974.4) and remains under the 30-day ($1,018), 5-day ($1,019) and 10-day ($1,044), holding well above the 200-day ($708.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 6 and is above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($1,098), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: 美光 10月13日下跌 3.6%，收于 $953.19，五个交易日下跌 9%。股价收于 100 日均线（$974.4）下方，并仍低于 30 日（$1,018）、5 日（$1,019）和 10 日均线（$1,044），远高于 200 日均线（$708.6）。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$1,098），RSI 为 40。

read.en: The break below the 100-day average and the $972 support turns that zone into first resistance. Above it are $1,018–1,019 (30 and 5-day averages) and $1,044 (10-day). Support is $929 (Oct 13 low), then $903 (Sep 14 low) and $888 (Aug 24 low). A close below $903 would open $888; back above $975 would ease the pressure.
read.zh: 跌破 100 日均线及 $972 支撑后，该区域转为第一阻力。其上为 $1,018–1,019（30 日和 5 日均线）及 $1,044（10 日均线）。支撑为 $929（10月13日低点），其次 $903（9月14日低点）和 $888（8月24日低点）。若收盘跌破 $903，下一目标看 $888；重回 $975 上方则压力缓解。
